annotations.text:
THE CHANGE

The old flow was a 6-step form wizard: onboarding, progress bar, Claimant Information, submit.

Here the form is the LAST thing, and it is locked. The spine is the reporting period, and the tabs are Period / Ledger / Queue / Form — so the queue is a destination, not a footnote.

Home is not a progress bar. It is the two accounts, each with its own arithmetic and its own MATCH or VARIANCE verdict.

TWO PARTIES, TWO ACCOUNTS

'Claimant Information' collapsed a payee and a beneficiary into one person. Setup now names both: FILING AS (you) and ON BEHALF OF (them), with relationship and adult/minor, which change what the form asks.

The accounts never merge either. Regular and dedicated ingest, classify and reconcile on separate tracks, and the ledger makes you pick one — there is no combined view to misread.

THE QUEUE IS THE PRODUCT

Everything upstream is arithmetic the app can do alone. This is the only part that needs what you know.

Two kinds of exception share the queue and must not look alike: TXN-184 is a transaction missing evidence; VAR-REG-01 is the account itself not tying by $126. One is answered with a receipt, the other with an explanation.

On the resolve screen the statement fields sit in a locked grey block. Your answer is appended as a new event — the original row is never rewritten.

THE GATE, AND THE OFF-RAMP

Every answered field carries the sum that produced it and the transaction count behind it. Two fields are blank on purpose, each naming the exception holding it up — the app will not print a number it cannot trace.

Filing is a recommendation, not a button. Two open judgment calls means in person, and the screen says which two. Online is greyed with its real reason: one sitting, no attachments, nowhere to explain a variance.
